find_frequent_element: find the most frequent element in an array using a hash map approach
run_f_gold: run f_gold with an array and count to find the most frequent element
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to validate correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use collections.Counter instead of a manual hash map
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts element frequencies and returns the most common one
